status: September 28 package rebuild in progress; balance unverified.

cards.name: Feral Chihuahua
cards.text: When this leaves play, deal 1 damage to the opposing Leader.

cards.name: Gas Station Daredevil
cards.text: When this attacks, you may deal 1 damage to it. If you do, it gets +2 Power for this Attack.

cards.name: Firework Dad
cards.text: When this enters play, you may deal 1 damage to one of your Characters.

cards.name: Bachelorette Party
cards.flavor: Matching shirts. Conflicting alibis.

cards.name: Unsupervised Toddler
cards.text: Defiant. While this Character has damage, it gets +2 Power.

cards.name: Road Rage Ron
cards.text: While attacking a damaged Character, this gets +2 Power for that Attack.

cards.name: Scout With a Flare Gun
cards.text: When this enters play, deal 1 damage to a Character. If you dealt that damage to one of your Characters, it gets +1 Power this Turn.

cards.name: Pool Pirate
cards.text: When this attacks a damaged Character, deal 1 damage to that Character before combat damage.

cards.name: Pirate With No Exit Strategy
cards.flavor: The treasure map ends at the tow yard.

cards.name: Guy Who Definitely Read the Instructions
cards.text: When this enters play, deal 2 damage to another of your Characters or to your Leader.

cards.name: Fourth of July Showrunner
cards.text: When this enters play, deal 1 damage to each other Character. Whenever another of your Characters is dealt damage and survives, deal 1 damage to an opposing Character.

cards.name: Giga Chad
cards.flavor: Even his warm-up has a warm-up.

cards.name: Amateur Electrician
cards.text: While this Character has damage, it gets +3 Power.
cards.flavor: He watched most of a tutorial.

cards.name: Guy Who Brought His Own Ramp
cards.text: When this attacks, it gets +1 Power for this Attack for each other damaged Character you control.

cards.name: Jet Ski Mechanic
cards.text: Damage dealt by your Items to opposing Characters is increased by 1.

cards.name: Porch Pirate
cards.text: Hothead.
cards.flavor: Free shipping. For him.

cards.name: Vape Kid
cards.text: When this enters play, you may deal 1 damage to this Character. If you do, Draw a card, then Discard a card.
cards.flavor: The cloud has entered the group chat.

cards.name: Minibike Menace
cards.text: Hothead. When this attacks, you may deal 1 damage to each of your other Characters. This gets +1 Power for this Attack for each Character damaged this way.

cards.name: Hold My Beer
cards.text: Choose one of your Characters. Deal 1 damage to it. It gets +2 Power this Round, or +3 Power if it is a Daredevil.

cards.name: Send It!
cards.text: Response — Before combat damage is dealt: One of your Characters gets +3 Power and -1 Guard for this combat.

cards.name: Glory Days
cards.text: Ready one of your Rotated Characters that attacked this Round. It gets +2 Power this Round and cannot Attack again this Round.
cards.flavor: The story gets faster every year.

cards.name: No, I'm Fine
cards.text: Draw 2 cards. Deal 1 damage to one of your Characters.

cards.name: Fireworks Incident
cards.text: Choose one of your Characters and an opposing Character. Deal 2 damage to each. If your Character survives, Draw a card, then Discard a card.

cards.name: Commit to the Bit
cards.text: One of your Ready Characters gets +4 Power this Round and skips its next Ready step.

cards.name: Floor It!
cards.text: Ready one of your Rotated Characters. Deal 2 damage to it.

cards.name: Walk It Off
cards.text: Heal up to 2 damage from a Character. Draw a card for each damage healed this way. Then deal 1 damage to that Character.

cards.name: Gas Station Pills
cards.text: Attach to one of your Characters. It gets +1 Power. Dismiss this: Ready the attached Character and deal 1 damage to it.

cards.name: Roman Candle
cards.text: Attach to one of your Characters. Rotate: Deal 1 damage to an opposing Character. If the attached Character is not a Scout, deal 1 damage to it too.

cards.name: Hot Potato
cards.text: When this enters play, place it beside the opposing Leader. At the end of each Turn, deal 1 damage to the Leader this is beside. Then that player may Rotate one of their Ready Characters. If they do, move this beside the other Leader.

cards.name: Homemade Launch Ramp
cards.text: Attach to one of your Characters. When it attacks, you may Dismiss this. If you do, it gets +3 Power for this Attack. After the Attack, deal 1 damage to it.

cards.name: Wedding Cover Band
cards.flavor: We take requests. Mostly to turn it down.

cards.name: Wedding DJ
cards.text: During your Ready step, if this Character is Rotated, you may leave it Rotated. While it remains Rotated this way, your other Musicians cost 1 less.

cards.name: Karaoke Champion
cards.text: While you have 2 or fewer cards in hand, this gets +2 Power.

cards.name: Jam Band Hippie
cards.text: Whenever you play a card while you have 2 or fewer cards in hand, heal 1 damage from a Character.

cards.name: Youth Pastor With a Guitar
cards.flavor: Three chords. Forty-seven announcements.

cards.name: Stage Mom
cards.text: When this enters play, another of your Characters gets +1 Power this Turn. Your other Parent and Kid Characters get +1 Guard.

cards.name: Reunion Tour Drummer
cards.text: While there are 6 or more Characters and Items in play, your other Musicians get +1 Power.
cards.flavor: The band said they were getting everybody back together.

cards.name: Mike
cards.flavor: Mike.

cards.name: Social Media Influencer
cards.text: When this enters play, look at the top card of an opponent's deck. While this remains in play, opponents play with the top card of their deck revealed.

cards.name: Boss Babe
cards.text: When this enters play, if an opponent has more cards in hand than you, Draw until you have the same number of cards.

cards.name: Overenthusiastic Softball Mom
cards.text: When this enters play, heal 2 damage from a Character. Your other Kid Characters get +1 Guard.

cards.name: Peaked in High School
cards.text: While you have fewer cards in hand than an opponent, your other Characters get +1 Power.
cards.flavor: He still calls the principal “Coach.”

cards.name: Guy Who Mows at 7 AM
cards.text: When this enters play, you may Stash an additional card from your hand.
cards.flavor: Everybody is awake now.

cards.name: Clown Who Booked the Wrong Gig
cards.flavor: The invitation said “bring something for the grill.”

cards.name: Basic White Girl
cards.flavor: The itinerary is mostly iced coffee.

cards.name: Single Dad
cards.text: When this enters play, another of your Characters gets +2 Guard this Round. If that Character is a Kid, heal 1 damage from it.

cards.name: Cookie Scout
cards.text: When this enters play, if an opponent has more cards in hand than you, Draw a card.

cards.name: Roadie Who Never Left
cards.text: Whenever you play a card costing 3 or more, your next card this Turn costs 1 less.

cards.name: Reply All
cards.text: Each player Draws a card. Then Draw a card.
cards.flavor: You do not need to be on this thread.

cards.name: Roll Call
cards.text: Look at the top 4 cards of your deck. You may reveal a Character and put it into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom in any order.

cards.name: Carpool
cards.text: Return an opposing Character costing 2 or less to its owner's hand. If that opponent now has more cards in hand than you, Draw a card.

cards.name: Encore!
cards.text: Choose an Action in your discard costing 1 or less. You may Play it without paying its Cost. If you do, put it on the bottom of your deck instead of into your discard.

cards.name: One More Song
cards.text: Ready one Stash. If you have 2 or fewer cards in hand, Ready another Stash.

cards.name: Reset the Vibes
cards.text: Each player Discards their hand, then Draws 3 cards.
cards.flavor: Nobody remembers what the original plan was.

cards.name: Bring a Friend
cards.text: The next Character you Play this Round costs 1 less. When it enters play, you may give another of your Characters +1 Power this Round.

cards.name: Parking Lot Pep Talk
cards.text: A Character gets +1 Power and +2 Guard this Turn. If it is a Parent, Kid, Musician, or Clown, Draw a card, then Discard a card.

cards.name: Participation Trophy
cards.text: Attach to one of your Characters. While you have fewer cards in hand than an opponent, the attached Character gets +2 Power.

cards.name: Orange Slices
cards.text: Dismiss this: Heal up to 3 damage from a Character. If you have fewer cards in hand than an opponent, Draw a card.

cards.name: Portable Bluetooth Speaker
cards.text: Your Musician Characters get +1 Power.

cards.name: Starter Kit
cards.text: When this enters play, Draw a card, then Discard a card. Dismiss this: Your next Character this Turn costs 1 less.

cards.name: Magician's Assistant
cards.text: When this enters play, you may Return another of your Characters to your hand.

cards.name: Birthday Kid Who Knows the Trick
cards.text: When this enters play, look at the top 2 cards of your deck. Put one on top and the other on the bottom.

cards.name: Rabbit
cards.text: When this Character is Returned from play to your hand, Draw a card.

cards.name: Volunteer From the Audience
cards.text: When this enters play, reveal the top card of an opponent's deck. If it is a Character, you may put it into play under your control. At the end of your Turn, put that Character into its owner's discard. Otherwise, put the revealed card on the bottom of its owner's deck.

cards.name: Escape Artist
cards.text: When this attacks, after it deals attack damage, you may Return it to your hand before retaliation.

cards.name: Off-Duty Clown
cards.text: Whenever another of your Characters is Returned from play to your hand, Draw a card, then Discard a card.

cards.name: School Bully
cards.text: Chicken. Opposing Characters with Power 2 or less cannot Block.
cards.flavor: Toughest kid on the playground until somebody swings back.

cards.name: Social Media Grifter
cards.text: When this enters play, Draw 2 cards, then Discard 2 cards.

cards.name: Conspiracy Blogger
cards.text: At the start of your Turn, name Character, Action, or Item. Reveal the top card of your deck. If you named its type, put it into your hand. Otherwise, put it on the bottom of your deck.

cards.name: Tech Bro
cards.flavor: It’s a normal doorbell, but the subscription is mandatory.

cards.name: Coupon Scammer
cards.flavor: The expiration date is more of a suggestion.

cards.name: Neighborhood Group Admin
cards.text: Whenever an opponent's effect Returns one of your Characters to your hand, that opponent Discards a card.
cards.flavor: Thirty-seven missed alerts. One unfamiliar sedan.

cards.name: IT Guy Who Quit Six Months Ago
cards.text: You may look at your Stash. When this enters play, you may Return one card from your Stash to your hand. If you do, put a card from your hand into your Stash Rotated.

cards.name: Identity Thief
cards.text: When this enters play, choose another Character. This gains one of that Character's printed Traits and one of its printed keywords while that Character remains in play.

cards.name: Pirate Radio Operator
cards.text: When this attacks, an opponent chooses one: this gets +2 Power for this Attack; or you Draw a card, then Discard a card.

cards.name: Wi-Fi Bandit
cards.text: When this enters play, Return a random card from your Stash to your hand. Then put a card from your hand into your Stash Rotated.
cards.flavor: Your password is his password.

cards.name: Script Kiddie
cards.text: When this enters play, look at one card in your Stash. You may Return it to your hand. If you do, put a card from your hand into your Stash Rotated.

cards.name: Pirate With a Business License
cards.text: Whenever an opponent makes a choice instructed by one of your cards, reveal the top card of your deck. If it costs 2 or less, you may Play it without paying its Cost. Otherwise, put it on the bottom of your deck.
cards.flavor: Every trick is fully licensed, bonded, and questionably insured.

cards.name: Pick a Card
cards.text: If you have fewer than 3 cards in hand, Draw until you have 3. Shuffle your hand face down. An opponent chooses one card. Reveal it. You may Play it without paying its Cost.

cards.name: Now You See Me
cards.text: Return one of your Characters to your hand. Then you may Play a Character costing 2 or less from your hand by paying 1 less.

cards.name: Look Over There!
cards.text: Response — When one of your Characters is attacked: Return that Character to your hand.

cards.name: Wrong Address
cards.text: Choose two opposing Characters. Their owner chooses one of them. Return that Character to its owner's hand. If they have only one Character, choose and Return that Character instead.

cards.name: Terms and Conditions
cards.text: An opponent Discards a card. If they have more cards in hand than you, they Discard another card.

cards.name: Default Password
cards.text: Return a random card from your Stash to your hand. Then put a card from your hand into your Stash Rotated.

cards.name: Have You Tried Turning It Off?
cards.text: Return a Rotated Item or Character to its owner's hand.

cards.name: Switcheroo
cards.text: Choose one of your Characters and an opposing Character with equal or lower Cost. Return both to their owners' hands.

cards.name: Burner Phone
cards.text: Rotate: Look at up to 2 cards in your Stash. You may Return one to your hand. If you do, put a card from your hand into your Stash Rotated.

cards.name: Marked Deck
cards.text: Rotate: Look at the top card of your deck. You may put it on the bottom.

cards.name: Lady Who's Moving Out Again
cards.text: When this Character is Returned from play to your hand, Draw cards equal to the damage on it.
cards.flavor: The truck is still warm from last time.

cards.name: Spoofed Keycard
cards.text: Rotate: An opposing Character cannot Block this Turn. If you have a Criminal or Pirate in play, it also gets -1 Power this Turn.

cards.name: Scout Troop Quartermaster
cards.flavor: Prepared for everything except the inspection.

cards.name: Guy Fixing His Trans Am
cards.text: When this enters play, Return an Item from your discard to your hand. Your Jerry-Rig cards enter your Stash Ready instead of Rotated.
cards.flavor: It has been almost running for three summers.

cards.name: Garage Inventor
cards.text: Whenever you Dismiss one of your Items, Draw a card, then Discard a card.

cards.name: Dumpster Diver
cards.text: When this enters play, look at the top 3 cards of your deck. You may reveal an Item and put it into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom in any order.

cards.name: Hoarder
cards.text: When this enters play, Return an Item costing 2 or less from your discard to your hand. While you have 6 or more cards in hand, your Items cost 1 less.
cards.flavor: It is not clutter if there is a system.
cards.art_note: A backyard bunker stocked from curbside giveaways and salvaged supplies.

cards.name: Shopping Cart Knight
cards.text: Slowpoke.
cards.flavor: Sir Carts-a-Lot yields to no curb.

cards.name: Junkyard Dog
cards.flavor: Beware of dog. Also tetanus.

cards.name: Raccoon of Unusual Size
cards.text: When this enters play, you may put an Item from your discard on the bottom of your deck. If you do, Draw a card. When this attacks, you may Dismiss one of your Items. If you do, this gets +2 Power for this Attack.

cards.name: Crazy Cat Lady
cards.text: At the start of your Turn, look at the top 3 cards of your deck. You may reveal a Character and put it into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom in any order. If the revealed Character is an Animal, heal 1 damage from a Character.
cards.flavor: Every cat has a name. The neighbors have numbers.

cards.name: Wind-Up Toy
cards.text: Sucker Punch. When this attacks a Ready Character, this gets +1 Power for that Attack.
cards.flavor: No batteries required. No brakes included.

cards.name: Extension Cord Electrician
cards.text: When this enters play, you may Ready one of your Items. If you have another Builder in play, Draw a card, then Discard a card.

cards.name: Rat King
cards.text: When this enters play, you may Return an Animal from your discard to your hand. Your other Rat Characters get +1 Power.

cards.name: Possum in the Trash Can
cards.text: When this is Defeated, you may Dismiss one of your Items. If you do, Return this from your discard to your hand.

cards.name: Trash Palace Cockroach
cards.text: When this is Defeated, you may put it from your discard on the bottom of your deck.

cards.name: Jailbroken Robot Vacuum
cards.text: Whenever you play an Item, put the top card of your deck into your discard. This gets +1 Power for each Item in your discard, up to +3 Power.
cards.flavor: The knife attachment voided the warranty.

cards.name: Shopping Cart Golem
cards.text: While you have a face-up card in your Stash, this gets +2 Power.
cards.flavor: One wheel squeaks. One wheel seeks revenge.

cards.name: Curbside Mechanic
cards.text: When this enters play, you may Return an Item costing 1 from your discard to your hand.

cards.name: Unlicensed Pool Guy
cards.text: When this enters play, Return an Item from your discard to your hand. Your Items cost 1 less.

cards.name: Scrounge
cards.text: Look at the top 3 cards of your deck. You may reveal an Item and put it into your hand. Put the rest into your discard.

cards.name: I Can Fix That
cards.text: Return an Item costing 1 from your discard to your hand.

cards.name: Cash In the Clutter
cards.text: Choose up to 3 Ready Stash controlled by either player and Rotate them. Draw a card for each Stash Rotated this way.
cards.flavor: Somebody was going to use it eventually.

cards.name: That's Probably Still Good
cards.text: Heal 2 damage from a Character, or 3 damage if it is a Scavenger.

cards.name: Make It Work
cards.text: Dismiss one of your Items. If you do, Draw 2 cards. Your next Item this Turn costs 1 less.

cards.name: Curb Alert
cards.text: Return an Item costing 1 or less from your discard to your hand. If you have more cards in hand than an opponent, Draw a card, then Discard a card.

cards.name: Don't Throw That Away
cards.text: Return an Item that entered your discard this Round to your hand.

cards.name: Good as New
cards.text: Choose a damaged Character. Heal all damage from it, then Rotate it.

cards.name: Duct Tape
cards.text: Jerry-Rig. Attach to one of your Characters. It gets +1 Guard. Rotate: Heal 1 damage from the attached Character, or 2 damage if it is a Construct.

cards.name: Zip Ties
cards.text: Jerry-Rig. Attach to one of your Characters. Dismiss this: The attached Character gets +2 Guard this Turn, or +3 Guard if it is a Builder.

cards.name: Mystery Drawer of Cables
cards.text: Jerry-Rig. When this enters play, Draw a card, then Discard a card. Rotate, Dismiss this: Ready another of your Items.

cards.name: Used Ham Sandwich
cards.text: Jerry-Rig. Dismiss this: Heal 2 damage from a Character. If it is a Scavenger, Draw a card, then Discard a card.

cards.name: Grumpy Old Guy
cards.text: When this Blocks, the attacker gets -1 Power for this Attack.

cards.name: HOA Enforcement Committee
cards.text: Opposing Characters played while their controller has more Characters in play than you enter play Rotated.

cards.name: Coupon Lady
cards.text: When this enters play, you may Stash an additional card from your hand.
cards.flavor: She has a binder. You have a problem.

cards.name: Mall Walker
cards.text: During your Ready step, if this Character is Rotated, you may leave it Rotated. If you do, choose an opposing Rotated Character. That Character does not Ready during its controller's next Ready step.

cards.name: Keyboard Warrior
cards.text: Whenever an opponent plays an Action, this gets +1 Power and +1 Guard this Turn.
cards.flavor: Brave enough to hit send.

cards.name: Crossing Guard
cards.text: Bodyguard.

cards.name: PTA President
cards.text: When this enters play, heal 1 damage from a Character. Your other Parent and Kid Characters get +1 Guard.

cards.name: Retired Marine Next Door
cards.text: Stubborn.
cards.flavor: Quiet neighborhood. Strict perimeter.

cards.name: HOA Vice President
cards.text: Opposing Characters costing 2 or less enter play Rotated.
cards.flavor: Vice is not silent.

cards.name: Linda From Neighborhood Watch
cards.text: When this enters play, look at an opponent's hand. Whenever an opponent Draws outside their Draw step, you may Draw a card, then Discard a card.

cards.name: Old Dog
cards.text: When this Blocks and survives, heal 1 damage from it.

cards.name: Church Potluck Grandma
cards.text: At the start of your Turn, heal 1 damage from another Character.

cards.name: Concrete Goose
cards.text: Slowpoke.
cards.flavor: The association has approved its use of force.

cards.name: Church Usher
cards.text: When this enters play, you may give another of your Characters +1 Guard this Round.

cards.name: Mall Cop
cards.text: This Character cannot Attack. While this is Ready, other Characters cannot use Hothead.
cards.flavor: No running.

cards.name: Tow-Truck Driver
cards.text: When this enters play, choose a Rotated opposing Character. Its owner may Discard a card. If they do not, that Character skips its next Ready step.

cards.name: HOA Lawyer
cards.text: Opposing Actions that target one or more of your cards cost 1 more.

cards.name: Neighborhood Lifeguard
cards.text: Opposing damaged Characters get -1 Power.
cards.flavor: NO RUNNING includes whatever this is.

cards.name: File a Complaint
cards.text: An opposing Character gets -2 Power this Round.

cards.name: Not in My Neighborhood
cards.text: Choose a Rotated opposing Character. Its owner may Discard a card. If they do not, it skips its next Ready step.

cards.name: Absolutely Not
cards.text: Response — When an opponent plays an Action: Cancel that Action.

cards.name: I Want to Speak to Your Manager
cards.text: Return an Item or Character costing 2 or less to its owner's hand.

cards.name: Read the Fine Print
cards.text: A Character gets -1 Power and -1 Guard this Round.

cards.name: 'Tis But a Scratch
cards.text: Heal 3 damage from your Leader. This costs 1 less if your Leader has less Health than the opposing Leader.

cards.name: Dig In
cards.text: Your Characters get +1 Guard this Round. If you have fewer Characters in play than an opponent, Draw a card.

cards.name: Wait Them Out
cards.text: Draw a card. If you have not Attacked this Turn, heal 2 damage from a Character.

cards.name: Security Camera
cards.text: Whenever an opposing Character becomes Rotated outside combat, Draw a card, then Discard a card.

cards.name: Video Doorbell
cards.text: Whenever an opposing Character Attacks your Leader, Draw a card, then Discard a card.

cards.name: Occupied Stroller
cards.text: Attach to one of your Characters. It gets +2 Guard, or +3 Guard if it is a Parent or Kid. When the attached Character would take damage, you may Dismiss this to prevent 2 of that damage.
cards.flavor: The safest place in the neighborhood is behind it.

cards.name: Grandma's Cigarette Case
cards.text: Whenever an opponent Readies a card outside their Ready step, Ready one of your Rotated Items.

cards.name: First-Time Wrestler
cards.flavor: Signed the waiver in crayon.

cards.name: Florida Man's Stunt Double
cards.text: Hothead. When this is Defeated during an Attack, deal 1 damage to the opposing Leader.

cards.name: Zombie Kid, Turtle Fan
cards.text: When this enters play, look at the top 3 cards of your deck. You may reveal an Animal or Undead Character and put it into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom in any order.

cards.name: Dumpster Zombie
cards.flavor: Taking “eat out of the trash” in a concerning direction.

cards.name: Retired Crash-Test Dummy
cards.text: When this enters play, you may Sacrifice another Character. If you do, your next card this Turn costs 2 less.

cards.name: Rooster Nobody Can Catch
cards.flavor: Seven counties. Six warrants. Zero witnesses.

cards.name: Fireworks Technician
cards.text: Whenever you Sacrifice another Character, deal 1 damage to an opposing Character.

cards.name: Patio-Table Prodigy
cards.text: Hothead.
cards.flavor: The patio set was still under warranty.

cards.name: Rabid Rat
cards.text: When this is Defeated, another of your Characters gets +2 Power this Turn. If it is a Rat or Undead, it also gets +1 Guard this Turn.

cards.name: Gym Selfie Guy
cards.flavor: Three sets. Forty-seven takes.

cards.name: Zombie Mall Walker
cards.text: When this is Defeated, you may Return it from your discard to your hand at the end of this Round.

cards.name: Guy Who Cut the Wrong Wire
cards.flavor: He remembers it as more of a group decision.

cards.name: Dumpster Phoenix
cards.text: Once during your Turn, you may Play an Undead Character from your discard by paying its Cost. When you do, Sacrifice another Character.

cards.name: Stunt Clown
cards.text: Defiant. Explosive.

cards.name: Backyard Wrestling Superfan
cards.text: When this enters play, another of your Characters gets +1 Power this Turn. Your other Wrestler Characters have Hothead.

cards.name: Backyard Tag-Team Captain
cards.text: Whenever you Play a Character during an opponent's Turn, Draw a card, then Discard a card.

cards.name: Rat in the Fireworks Box
cards.text: When this is Defeated, deal 1 damage to the opposing Leader.

cards.name: Guy Who Took the Chair Shot
cards.text: Whenever this Character survives combat with damage, Draw a card.

cards.name: Take One for the Team
cards.text: Response — Before damage would be dealt to your Leader: Sacrifice one of your Characters. Prevent up to 3 of that damage.

cards.name: This Seemed Like a Good Idea
cards.text: Choose two of your Characters. Sacrifice one of them. If you do, the other gets +2 Power and +2 Guard this Turn.

cards.name: Worth It
cards.text: Choose one of your Characters and another Character. Sacrifice your chosen Character. If you do, deal damage equal to its last Power to the other chosen Character.

cards.name: Tag Me In!
cards.text: Return one of your damaged Characters to your hand. If you do, you may Play a different Character from your hand with equal or lower Cost without paying its Cost. If the returned Character was a Wrestler, the new Character gains Hothead this Round.
cards.flavor: I’ve got this. Please do not ask what “this” is.

cards.name: Again!
cards.text: Return a Character costing 2 or less from your discard to your hand. If it is Undead and one of your Characters was Defeated this Round, it costs 1 less the next time you Play it this Round.

cards.name: Sign the Waiver
cards.text: Sacrifice one of your Characters. If you do, Draw 2 cards, then Discard a card.

cards.name: Light the Fuse
cards.text: Sacrifice one of your Characters. If you do, deal 1 damage to the opposing Leader, or 2 damage if the sacrificed Character was Undead or a Daredevil.

cards.name: Keep It Going!
cards.text: If one of your Characters was Defeated during your Turn this Round, Ready one Fuel and Draw a card. You may Play only one Keep It Going! each Round.

cards.name: Bath Salts
cards.text: Attach to one of your Characters. It gains Undead. Dismiss this: The Character this was attached to gets +2 Power this Round.

cards.name: Folding Chair
cards.text: Attach to one of your Characters. Dismiss this: The Character this was attached to gets +2 Power this Round, or +3 Power if it is a Wrestler.

cards.name: Definitely Safe Helmet
cards.text: Attach to one of your Characters. It gets +1 Guard. Rotate: Heal 1 damage from the attached Character.

cards.name: Button Marked DO NOT PRESS
cards.text: Rotate, Sacrifice one of your Characters: Deal 2 damage to an opposing Character. This Item skips its next Ready step.
